newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-MCINTOSH REPLACES FELLOW-NEW ZEALANDER TAYLOR.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-MCINTOSH REPLACES FELLOW-NEW ZEALANDER TAYLOR.

text.p: Pontypridd flanker Dale McIntosh has replaced fellow-New Zealander Hemi Taylor in the Wales' team to meet South Africa on Sunday.
Mark Rowley, another Pontypridd player, comes in for lock Derwyn Jones who played poorly in the 28-19 loss to Australia eight days ago.
Neil Jenkins, who lost his place at fly-half to Jonathan Davies, will play at full-back. Jenkins came on as a replacement for Wayne Proctor in the test against Australia.

Wales - Neil Jenkins; Ieuan Evans, Scott Gibbs, Gareth Thomas, Dafydd James; Jonathan Davies, Rob Howley; Steve Williams, Colin Charvis, Dale McIntosh, Mark Rowley, Gareth Llewellyn, David Young, Jonathan Humphreys, Christian Loader.
